name: napoland
description: napoland: a mobile-first online exploration game. Leave home, gather what glows, get back.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @napoland/client && npm run build -w @napoland/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client && tsc -p apps/client/test && tsc -p tools
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm run test
